row:
I'm an equestrian and canine entrepreneurial coach and consultant to veterinarians who want to help prevent animals being affected by domestic abuse.

I've over a decade's experience as a domestic abuse commissioning and strategy expert combined with a lifelong love of animals, I've twice won the GHP award for most outstanding natural animal health consultancy. My informative website helps animal lovers across the world.

My podcast Animals Naturally has been downloaded over 7,200 times.

Feeling healthy is so important for us and our animals. To help with this I've used pure Aloe Vera and Essential Oils for years - for me and my horses and dogs wellbeing. I can help you too, as:

1) I'm an independent Forever Business Owner of Forever Living Products, the world's largest grower and producer of aloe vera. 
2) I'm a DoTERRA wellness advocate, selling their range of 100% pure essential oils.

These ranges are available via mail order across the world, visit my website for links
